未选择确认值时沿用文件声明；文件未声明则显示未知。这里只标记单位，不换算原始频率: Without an explicit confirmation, use the file declaration; if the file has no declaration, display an unknown unit. This choice labels the unit without converting the original frequencies.
主文件已改变：频率和长度确认已重置，旧伴随结构已清除；请核对新来源后手动运行。: The primary file has changed. Frequency and length confirmations have been reset and the previous companion structure has been cleared. Check the new source, then run manually.
新主文件已载入：请重新确认单位并配对同一原胞的伴随结构，然后手动运行。: A new primary file has loaded. Reconfirm the units and pair a companion structure for the same primitive cell, then run manually.
本征矢由 Phonopy 对官方 ZnO 力数据离线后处理生成，本例关闭 NAC: The eigenvectors were generated by offline Phonopy postprocessing of official ZnO force data with NAC disabled. This qpoints output was derived from those inputs rather than taken from the original repository; no new first-principles calculation was performed on this site.
伴随原胞与固定版本原文逐字节一致。: The companion primitive-cell file matches the pinned original byte for byte.
伴随原胞未与固定原文逐字节匹配；请核对所用原胞、原子顺序和质量。: The companion primitive-cell file does not match the pinned original byte for byte. Check its primitive cell, atom order, and masses.
导入文件身份见来源记录。: See the source record for the imported file's identity.
自定义模式表单显式显示频率单位确认。未确认时沿用主文件已有的声明；主文件没有声明: The custom-mode form displays frequency-unit confirmation explicitly. Without confirmation, it uses the primary file's declaration; when none is present, it displays an undeclared unit. Selecting THz, cm⁻¹, or meV labels the original numbers without converting frequencies. This choice is separate from the file's length unit and the length conversion used for frozen-structure export.
从声子导入器送入的确认值和伴随原胞会显示在表单中。普通标签切换、相位或 q 点调: Confirmation values and the companion primitive cell transferred from the phonon importer are visible in the form. Ordinary tab, phase, and q-point changes retain them. Successfully loading different primary-file content or editing the primary text resets frequency confirmation and the length override and clears the previous companion cell; pair the new files and run manually. Selecting identical primary-file content retains confirmation. Replacing the companion cell refreshes length metadata while retaining the primary file's frequency confirmation.
